Business hire FAQs

Business van hire, answered

1Can I hire a van long-term for my business or ABN?

Yes. Long-term van hire is popular with trades, couriers and businesses that want a work-ready vehicle without tying up capital in a purchase or a rigid lease.

2How much does business van hire cost?

The iLoad starts from $100 per day, with better weekly and monthly rates the longer you hire. Call 0435 800 248 for a long-term quote.

3Can I add a van just for a busy period or project?

Absolutely. That is one of the main reasons businesses hire long-term — add capacity when you need it and hand the van back when the work eases.

4Is there a long lock-in contract?

No. Hire is flexible and month to month, so you are not locked into a multi-year lease.
